title: Amazon S3 to AWS Lambda to Amazon Polly
description: Convert text to speech when uploading a file into S3

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how convert text to speech by uploading the text to S3.
The S3 uses an event trigger to invoke a Lambda function which uses Amazon Polly for to convert the text to speech.
